b: Waypoint TV, the destination for outdoor entertainment, is proud to announce the premiere of Hunting Land Man Season 4, launched on Waypoint TV.

Hosted by Slade Priest, one of the country’s best real estate agents for hunting properties, Hunting Land Man delivers a firsthand look at everything that goes into buying, improving, and flipping hunting land. Season 4 takes viewers from the turkey woods of southwest Mississippi to the whitetail country of the Midwest, with Slade and his crew putting in the work on the ground and the habitat.

Whether viewers are interested in real estate, looking to flip a property, or simply want to improve their own piece of ground for hunting and recreation, the series is a one-stop shop for land education and hunting entertainment.

“Hunting Land Man has built a loyal following by showing what it really takes to find, improve, and enjoy great hunting ground. Season 4 delivers the same authentic, hands-on storytelling our viewers love, and we’re proud to have Slade and the crew on Waypoint TV.”
— Builder Brock, Co-Founder & CEO, Waypoint TV
Viewers can catch up on Seasons 1 through 3 anytime on the Waypoint TV app and website.
